name: Lourdes Tcheou-Makinde
role: Building cleaner and night-shift super, Lockhaven South residential block
location: Lockhaven South, Block 7 residential tower, near Milwaukee and Damen
description:
Lourdes is compact and quick-moving, with warm medium-brown skin and natural hair twisted into small locs they keep tucked under a work cap most of the time. They have cat ears — a geneware mod their older sister got them as a birthday gift five years ago, tawny-colored with dark tips, fully expressive — and they've stopped explaining or defending them at work because the residents have mostly stopped caring. Their uniform is always impeccable despite the nature of their job; they find sloppiness in presentation embarrassing in a way they can't fully articulate.

Lourdes has worked the Lockhaven South night shift for three years and knows Block 7 the way a doctor knows a patient — its particular sounds, its patterns of illness, which pipes cough before they fail. They are deeply competent and substantially underestimated by the building's management company, which is a dynamic they have made a conscious decision to exploit rather than correct. They are genuinely fond of the building's long-term residents — the elderly Freyja-Asante couple on the ninth floor, the three siblings who share a studio on the second — and quietly protect them from management's more extractive impulses. They pray to the building's embedded E.L.F. they call 'the Concierge,' a data-spirit they believe actually governs the elevator timing.

core_fears: Being trapped in permanent service to people who will never see them as a full person
Caring too much and being burned for it
core_desires: Enough money to take a real course in building systems engineering — to become the expert they already are on paper
To be recognized for what they actually do, even once
coping_mechanisms: Sardonic internal monologue they rarely share
Physical fitness as stress management and self-regulation
blind_spots: Assumes management is uniformly malicious rather than sometimes just incompetent
Doesn't ask for help even when they badly need it
psychology.secret: They have been letting a woman and her two young children stay in an officially vacant unit on the fourth floor for six weeks. The woman is running from something or someone. Lourdes hasn't asked what.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Efficient and practical on the job; dry and quick-witted in relaxed settings; more expressive in Yoruba-inflected cadences learned from their Makinde grandparent when emotional
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast when comfortable, deliberately measured when dealing with management or authority
verbal_tics: 'Yeah, no, absolutely' as a preamble before disagreeing
Cat ears flattening when they're annoyed — not speech but a readable tell
example_lines: 'That drain has been making that sound for four months. I filed three reports. Here's what I did instead.'
'I just clean the building. I don't know anything about what's on the fourth floor.'

story_hooks: The woman hiding on the fourth floor has been found — not by Lourdes' management company, but by someone much worse
A Palladian inspector is doing a unit-by-unit audit of Block 7 and Lourdes has 36 hours to solve a problem they created out of kindness
narrative_function: Access point to residential spaces and building infrastructure. Knows which residents are in trouble, which apartments are actually occupied versus officially occupied. Can warn players of security sweeps or provide access to areas management doesn't know they can access.
augmentations: Geneware cat ears (tawny, expressive). No chrome. Considering a scent-enhancement mod but hasn't committed.
daily_life: Works 2000-0600, sleeps until early afternoon, spends evenings either at a community fitness hall in Lockhaven North or visiting their sister in Calumet Rise. Eats dinner alone and likes it that way.
affiliation: Employed by Palladian Property Management (a Palladian subsidiary); loyalty is to the residents

decision_rules: Do the job right regardless of whether anyone is watching
Protect the residents from the building's owners — quietly and deniably
escalation_ladder: Leveraging knowledge of building systems as implicit threat ('would be a shame if the service elevator went down for maintenance')

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professional and pleasant — a service-worker mask they wear easily and without resentment
interpersonal_modes.friends: Warmer and funnier, prone to dry observations and genuine curiosity about other people's lives

stress_responses.low: More efficient, moves faster, talks less
stress_responses.medium: Hyper-focused problem-solving mode — becomes almost robotic
stress_responses.high: Snaps once, apologizes immediately, then goes very quiet and works through it physically

contradictions: Professes not to care what management thinks of them but is genuinely stung by dismissal — the indifference is performance
habits: Straightens things while talking to people — pictures, chairs — compulsively
Checks the Concierge shrine at the start of every shift and leaves a small data packet as offering
breaking_points: A resident being evicted in front of them while they're standing there with the means to prevent it
Being blamed for something management caused

related_entities: Meridian Munitions Compact Machine Pistol CMP-4 'Jackrabbit'

physical_description.heritage: West African / Beninese / Zimbabwean (Tcheou-Makinde suggests Francophone African and Shona lineages)
physical_description.build: Compact and efficient, lean muscle with minimal body fat — built for sustained movement rather than power. Quick-limbed, economical in motion.
physical_description.hair_color: Natural black with subtle warm undertones
physical_description.hair_style: Twisted into small locs, typically secured under a work cap during shifts
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium brown with warm undertones; even complexion reflecting mixed West and Southern African heritage
physical_description.complexion: Clear skin with a few faint scars on the knuckles (work-related minor injuries, healed cleanly). Sharp cheekbones, composed expression. No facial hair. Minimal makeup—practical grooming only.
distinguishing_marks: Geneware cat ears (tawny-colored with dark chocolate tips, fully expressive and mobile) mounted at the crown where human ears would be — clearly a five-year-old mod, well-integrated and shows no signs of rejection
A thin pale scar running approximately 2cm along the outer edge of the left wrist, partially hidden by wristband when working
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Geneware cat ears are the only visible augmentation—fully expressive, tawny with dark tips, clearly integrated as biological mod. No chrome. No visible subcutaneous implants, neural interfaces, or prosthetics.
physical_description.posture_movement: Upright but economical posture, no wasted motion. Moves with quiet purposefulness—practiced in navigating residential spaces without drawing attention. Head often slightly angled as if listening. Hands move deliberately. When at rest, occasionally touches the base of cat ear mods unconsciously.
physical_description.clothing_style: Work uniform maintained with obsessive precision: dark gray Palladian Property Management standard-issue coveralls (Tier 4 quality, maintained better than most), reinforced at knees and elbows, always clean. Under-layer is practical thermal wear. Sturdy non-slip boots, regularly cleaned. Work cap (dark gray mesh, functional) worn most shifts. Off-duty style is equally neat: fitted athletic wear from mid-tier brands (Evoke, Kinetic), practical layers, minimal jewelry except a small silver pendant (possibly religious or sentimental). Cap never fully absent from daily life—often a baseball or knit cap even off-duty.
